Game Overview

At its heart, Candy Catch is a hyper-casual game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of Candy Catch follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Candy Catch?

Candy Catch is a free hyper-casual game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Candy Catch free to play?

Yes, Candy Catch is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
